paper.title: EaDex: A Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation Framework from Low-Cost Demonstrations

claim: 仅使用单 RGB-D 相机（MediaPipe 检测 + 深度恢复腕部 3D + 在线 MANO 拟合 + 高斯平滑）采集的低成本演示，经重定向与演示引导 RL 后，在 3 种灵巧手 × 3 种关节物体共 9 个跨本体组合上取得平均 36.5% 成功率，部分任务最高 93.3%。

evidence.summary: 引言与 4.2 一致报告 36.5% 平均成功率与 93.3% 上限；采集管线细节（MediaPipe、深度腕部恢复、在线 MANO、高斯平滑）见 3.1。
evidence.short_quote:
Under low-cost demonstration conditions, EaDex achieves an average success
rate of 36.5% across nine cross-embodiment manipulation tasks, corresponding to a 55.3% relative
improvement over the baseline without demonstration annealing, and in some tasks, EaDex achieves
a success rate of up to 93.3%.

notes: ARCTIC 上退火增益（Ketchup 9.0→57.91±28.12、Waffleiron 9.1→23.01、Mixer 28.1→35.14，Table 1）因高方差未单独成卡，保留在 findings。Related Work 中“vision-based hand pose estimation is noisy and unreliable”为引用驱动动机陈述（引 DexMV/Ego4D），未单列证据卡。

paper_reading.relation: 为综述提供“低精度视觉手部演示仍可支撑跨本体策略学习”的可行性证据，并给出可用性量级参考（平均 36.5%、上限 93.3%）；说明可接受阈值是任务相关的——以接触先验为目标的关节开启任务可容忍低成本检测精度。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引言引文逐字核对，36.5%/93.3% 与 4.2 正文一致（4.2 存在断词 av-erage 故取引言版本）；任务/样本与成功判据取自 4.1；声明限定在仿真与关节开启任务。

quantitative.metric: task success rate (object stays on platform, final articulation angle > 45 deg)
quantitative.value_or_direction: average 36.5% across 9 cross-embodiment settings; up to 93.3% on some tasks
quantitative.task_or_sample: Genesis simulation, 3 dexterous hands x 3 articulated objects, 3 seeds

paper.title: EaDex: A Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation Framework from Low-Cost Demonstrations

claim: 固定演示权重会被低成本演示中的噪声带偏：在相同数据、奖励、预算与 PPO 配置下，接触奖励驱动的动态演示退火将平均成功率从 23.5% 提升到 36.5%（相对 +55.3%）；作者明确归因于“固定演示权重易受低成本演示噪声影响”。

evidence.summary: 4.3 消融原文同时给出 23.5%→36.5%（+55.3%）的定量对比与“fixed demonstration weights are prone to being affected by noise in low-cost demonstrations”的机理归因。
evidence.locator: 4.3 Ablation Study on Dynamic Demonstration Annealing
evidence.short_quote:
Compared to the fixed-weight setting, our method increases
the average success rate from 23.5% to 36.5%, a relative improvement of 55.3%. This demonstrates
that fixed demonstration weights are prone to being affected by noise in low-cost demonstrations,
whereas dynamic annealing retains demonstration guidance during early training and gradually re-
leases it as the policy achieves stable contact behaviors, thereby improving task success rates.

notes: ARCTIC 上退火增益（Ketchup 9.0→57.91±28.12、Waffleiron 9.1→23.01、Mixer 28.1→35.14，Table 1）因高方差未单独成卡，保留在 findings。Related Work 中“vision-based hand pose estimation is noisy and unreliable”为引用驱动动机陈述（引 DexMV/Ego4D），未单列证据卡。

paper_reading.relation: 直接命中综述的“噪声经演示传播”与“缓解手段”：检测/采集噪声进入演示轨迹后，固定权重模仿会把噪声当作监督信号；随策略掌握接触结构而衰减演示权重可显著缓解。条件：仿真关节开启任务、成功率口径。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字核对（含 re-leases 断词）；消融控制变量说明取自 4.3 首段；机理归因为作者原文，声明未超出该消融设置。

quantitative.comparator: w/o Annealing ablation with identical data, reward design, training budget, PPO configuration
quantitative.task_or_sample: 9 cross-embodiment settings (3 hands x 3 objects) on the low-cost RGB-D dataset
quantitative.locator: 4.3 Ablation Study on Dynamic Demonstration Annealing

paper.title: EaDex: A Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation Framework from Low-Cost Demonstrations

claim: 单 RGB-D 相机采集在手势被遮挡时关键点检测可能不完整；作者采用的缓解手段（控制腕部时采用参考姿态+局部偏移、让手掌尽量朝向相机）以减少遮挡，但承认这会轻微限制腕部动作的灵活性。

evidence.summary: 第 5 节 Limitations 原文完整陈述遮挡问题、缓解手段及其代价；与未来工作（多相机融合）呼应。
evidence.short_quote:
Our method uses a single RGB-D camera to capture hand motions. When gestures
are occluded, keypoint detection may be incomplete. To mitigate this issue, we adopt a reference
pose with local offsets when controlling the wrist, ensuring the palm faces the camera as much as
possible, which reduces occlusion. However, this approach can slightly limit the dexterity of wrist
motions.

notes: ARCTIC 上退火增益（Ketchup 9.0→57.91±28.12、Waffleiron 9.1→23.01、Mixer 28.1→35.14，Table 1）因高方差未单独成卡，保留在 findings。Related Work 中“vision-based hand pose estimation is noisy and unreliable”为引用驱动动机陈述（引 DexMV/Ego4D），未单列证据卡。

paper_reading.relation: 为综述的“误差来源-缓解-代价”链提供直接实例：单目/单视角 ego 风格采集的遮挡误差 → 姿态约束缓解 → 以牺牲腕部运动灵活性（即示教轨迹表达力）为代价。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字核对；遮挡→检测不全→姿态约束→灵活性代价的因果链均为作者原文陈述，读者未加推断。

paper.title: EaDex: A Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation Framework from Low-Cost Demonstrations

claim: 作者明确指出 RGB-D 感知与在线 MANO 拟合会给手部运动序列引入高频时序噪声，并在重定向与策略学习之前沿时间轴施加高斯平滑以提升运动序列的时序连续性。

evidence.summary: 3.1 原文说明噪声来源（RGB-D 感知、在线 MANO 拟合）与高斯平滑（式 3）的处理位置；该处理在数据进入重定向与 RL 之前完成。
evidence.short_quote:
To further
reduce high-frequency temporal noise introduced by RGB-D perception and online MANO fitting,
we apply Gaussian smoothing along the temporal axis

notes: ARCTIC 上退火增益（Ketchup 9.0→57.91±28.12、Waffleiron 9.1→23.01、Mixer 28.1→35.14，Table 1）因高方差未单独成卡，保留在 findings。Related Work 中“vision-based hand pose estimation is noisy and unreliable”为引用驱动动机陈述（引 DexMV/Ego4D），未单列证据卡。

paper_reading.relation: 为综述的误差来源清单确认一条具体路径（深度感知+在线模型拟合 → 高频时序噪声），并提供一种采集后处理级缓解手段（时序高斯平滑）；与 C02 的学习级缓解（退火）互补。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字核对；噪声来源与平滑手段的对应关系为作者原文；“在重定向之前”由 3.1 数据管线顺序（检测→MANO 拟合→平滑→ARCTIC 格式存储→重定向）确认。
